source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max({value for row in grid for value in row}, key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == background and row[c-1] == row[c+1] and row[c-1] != background:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
